integrity: The exact global index and all-length formula are established by a structural proof and accompanied by direct finite signature checks with reproducible code and complete class witnesses.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, at most four letters per pattern, at most one jumble. No claims for higher pattern lengths, larger alphabets, or higher jumble allowances. The equivalence is not asserted to be a congruence; the fixed-length counts enumerate signatures rather than words. The finite checker is supplementary to the symbolic proof. Historical priority beyond inspected sources is uncertain. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: Exact index and saturation spectrum of binary one-jumble four-Simon equivalence
